# FROZEN SNAPSHOT, NOT A LIVE MIRROR: the schema Python's Base.metadata.create_all created for
# agent_sessions and agent_session_events, captured while the Go models printed this text line for
# line - 30 lines each, diffed before this golden file was made (TEST-CHANGELOG 3040).
# Frozen 2026-10-09 at a50929c6, "chore: remove agenthub_main, the retired Python backend", which
# deleted the only source that could print it: it can NEVER be re-derived, agenthub_main is gone and
# no `class AgentSession` remains anywhere in this repository.
# The Go schema's deliberate divergences from it are declared in schema_test.go, each naming the commit
# that made it; anything else is drift, and the comparison fails in both directions.
== table agent_sessions
col id | character varying | 36 | NO | None | 1
col user_id | character varying | 64 | NO | None | 2
col connector_id | character varying | 64 | NO | None | 3
col session_key | character varying | 255 | NO | None | 4
col name | character varying | 255 | NO | None | 5
col project | character varying | 255 | YES | None | 6
col status | character varying | 20 | NO | None | 7
col last_seq | integer | None | NO | None | 8
col created_at | timestamp without time zone | None | NO | None | 9
col last_seen | timestamp without time zone | None | NO | None | 10
con agent_sessions_pkey | PRIMARY KEY (id)
con uq_agent_sessions_key | UNIQUE (user_id, connector_id, session_key)
idx agent_sessions_pkey | CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agent_sessions_pkey ON public.agent_sessions USING btree (id)
idx ix_agent_sessions_user_id | CREATE INDEX ix_agent_sessions_user_id ON public.agent_sessions USING btree (user_id)
idx uq_agent_sessions_key | CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_agent_sessions_key ON public.agent_sessions USING btree (user_id, connector_id, session_key)
== table agent_session_events
col id | integer | None | NO | nextval('agent_session_events_id_seq'::regclass) | 1
col session_id | character varying | 36 | NO | None | 2
col user_id | character varying | 64 | NO | None | 3
col seq | integer | None | NO | None | 4
col type | character varying | 32 | NO | None | 5
col payload | json | None | NO | None | 6
col ts | timestamp without time zone | None | NO | None | 7
con agent_session_events_pkey | PRIMARY KEY (id)
con agent_session_events_session_id_fkey | FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
con uq_agent_session_events_seq | UNIQUE (session_id, seq)
idx agent_session_events_pkey | CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agent_session_events_pkey ON public.agent_session_events USING btree (id)
idx idx_agent_session_events_user_session | CREATE INDEX idx_agent_session_events_user_session ON public.agent_session_events USING btree (user_id, session_id, seq)
idx uq_agent_session_events_seq | CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_agent_session_events_seq ON public.agent_session_events USING btree (session_id, seq)
